name: PHP2Shell

branches.note: Fix not merged into PHP-8.6 as of 2026-10-21 13:42 UTC. Pre-release builds without the patch fingerprint are vulnerable.
master (8.7.0-dev); fix not merged as of 2026-10-21. Pre-release builds (8.7.0-dev) without the patch fingerprint are vulnerable, like 8.6 pre-releases (SPEC section 3 rule 7).

patch_fingerprints.source: Zend/zend_alloc.c zend_mm_hard_limit_error(), added by the fix commit
main/main.c INI entry, added by the fix commit

fingerprint_limitations: PHP's minimal source backports for 7.4, 8.0 and 8.1 (branches PHP-x.y-CVE-2026-109618-109619) do not add these strings and keep the old version number. They cannot be told apart from unpatched builds by inspecting the binary. Only vendor evidence (package changelog naming the CVE) counts for those.

sapi_exposure.detail: PHP advisory: unauthenticated pre-application RCE demonstrated (request shutdown runs even after failed startup).
PHP advisory: calls request shutdown unconditionally like mod_php; likely susceptible to application-independent attacks.
PHP advisory: CVE-2026-109619 RCE validated via session upload progress; CVE-2026-109618 susceptible by source analysis.
PHP advisory: LSAPI models FPM; application-specific exploits likely but unvalidated.
php.net lists php-cgi among installations at risk when serving web requests.
Not a web SAPI. Only at risk if it is used to serve web requests.

interim_mitigations.how: Administratively (php_admin_value in FPM pool or Apache config); ensure nothing restores a finite limit; restart every worker.
Plus frontend limits on decoded body size, field/part/header counts and nesting, including requests without a usable Content-Length.
These cause the vulnerable allocation failure.
In php.ini, FPM pool or server config applied before request parsing (not ini_set() or .user.ini); restart every worker.
Administratively; restart every worker. Blocks the confirmed fatal-backtrace path only.
php_value/.htaccess (mod_php) and fastcgi_param PHP_VALUE/PHP_ADMIN_VALUE (FPM) that emit diagnostics before request initialization. Hiding diagnostics does not help.

vendor_notes.note: php.net: rpms.remirepo.net will not have updates on 2026-10-21; switch to distribution packages or build from source.
